extra.final_summary: Found and fixed two data problems affecting the per-island counts: (1) island label variants — "Dream " (trailing space), "Bisco" and "Torgerson" misspellings — merged into the allowed labels Dream/Biscoe/Torgersen via normalize_labels; (2) 2 exact duplicate rows removed via drop_duplicates so a penguin wasn't double-counted. After cleaning (52 rows), counts of penguins measured per island: Biscoe 28, Dream 16, Torgersen 8. Note: body_mass_g and sex had minor issues (text-formatted numbers, a "FEMALE" variant) but they don't affect this question and were left alone.
